Name: PRIMARY
Description: The primary header containing the keywords following the standard format

Name: RECEIPT
Description: The list of operations performed on this file

Name: DRP_CONFIG
Description: Pipeline details to go from the raw file to this file

Name: EXT_DESCRIPT
Description: Contains the description of all the extensions in the file

Name: ORDER_TABLE
Description: Table capturing the wavelength extent of each order as well as some extra info on SNR etc.

Name: TRACE1_WAVE
Description: The wavelength associated to the flux in trace 1

Name: BJD_TDB
Description: Photon weighted midpoint in BJD TDB
